$comment: Wildlife kinds (#10567, #10570): the first and second waves of old beasts on den-wiki (wandering-years/wildlife). Distances are metres, speeds metres a second, times seconds unless named days or hours. Habitat weights scale a kind's density by the share of a region's ground in each MapBiome.

kinds.name: Root-adder
kinds.$comment: Cave wildlife (#10876), on its own body since #10883: a constrictor that hangs from the cave mouth's ceiling among its roots and drops when it wakes, coiled on the ground, striking from the coil. Its height is how far its head hangs below its grip (2.2 m), which a hanging animal's reach is measured from.

kinds.name: Needle-mouth
kinds.$comment: The first fog foe (#10985), settled with Patch on den-wiki wandering-years/fog-wildlife ('Roster and rules'): a solid ribbon-eel that swims a mist sump's air about a metre over the floor and never leaves the mist. It hunts by sound, not sight: sightMetres is how far it hears a full-loudness noise (a run, a swing, a hard landing). It comes mouth first in long lunges at its flee pace, bites, and circles off before it comes again; its teeth click faster as it nears. Its body is faded into the mist and turns solid head first as it attacks (#10984). Placed by test aid only: placement through the sumps stays with #10174.

swim.$comment: #10995: its body follows its head on a chain, a wave down it as wide as waveMetres at waveSpeed (its lunge) and idleWaveMetres hovering, waveLengthMetres crest to crest, quiet over the head's share; the tail lags (lagHead to lagTail a second), it straightens as it slows, a threat or bite shows its clip through by strikeWeight, and its head eases after its facing over turnEaseSeconds.

fog.$comment: #10985: it swims floatMetres over the floor, bobbing; it comes at a noise heard within heardSeconds and feels the player within feelMetres in the mist; after a bite it circles off circleMetres from the player for circleSeconds; its teeth click every clickFarSeconds at the edge of its hearing, quickening to clickNearSeconds at the player.

kinds.name: Fade-ribbon
kinds.$comment: The fog foe that cuts the line (#10986), settled with Patch on den-wiki wandering-years/fog-wildlife ('Roster and rules'): a broad, paper-thin membrane 5 m long that swims a mist sump's air behind a long needle head, its rear always fading out, and never leaves the mist. Until the line (#10173) exists it hunts the player as a darter: hearing them in the mist it loops round them, and darts in to bite only when they come at it, then circles away. It flutters whenever it swims, so it is heard before it is seen. Placed by test aid only: placement through the sumps stays with #10174.

fade.$comment: Its rear always fades out: attacking it shows only strike of its length.

swim.$comment: #10995 as the needle-mouth's, looser at the tail, and twisting as a ribbon does (#10986): a wave of turning its face to its edge, twistWaveMetres crest to crest, twistDegrees at waveSpeed and idleTwistDegrees hovering.

fog.$comment: #10986: as the needle-mouth's (#10985), but it flutters (sound) whenever it swims, every clickFarSeconds far off to clickNearSeconds at the player; and it is a darter: within its hearing it loops round the player circleMetres off, loopDegrees round at a time for up to circleSeconds, and darts in only when they come within dartMetres.

kinds.name: Gulper
kinds.$comment: The fog foe that waits (#10987), settled with Patch on den-wiki wandering-years/fog-wildlife ('Roster and rules'): almost all mouth, two jaw rails 2.5 m long over a small body and a ribbon tail, hanging still in the thickest mist. It is a waiter: it never comes at the player, but holds still while it hears them and strikes once they pass within its reach, one huge bite, then withdraws and keeps off for its long cooldown. Its throat pulses slow and low even at rest, so it is heard before it is reached. At most one per sump. Placed by test aid only: placement through the sumps stays with #10174.

fog.$comment: #10987: a waiter. It hangs floatMetres over the floor, barely bobbing; it hears a full noise as far as sightMetres and feels the player within feelMetres; it holds still while it senses them, strikes once they are within its reach, withdraws circleMetres off for circleSeconds after a bite and whenever they come within its reach while it cools down (cooldownTicks), and rests where it is when it hears nothing. Its throat pulses every clickFarSeconds, quickening to clickNearSeconds at the player.

kinds.name: Mouldback
kinds.$comment: Cave wildlife (#10876); its own body (#10877), resting flat as one more patch of fungus.

kinds.name: Drowner
kinds.$comment: Cave wildlife (#10876); its own body (#10879) on the saurian rig: it rests lying low in its pool's shallows (its home is the pool's middle, over a bed a few tenths of a metre down), lunges from the water as its bite, and crawls out after what it missed.

kinds.name: Hummock
kinds.$comment: Cave wildlife (#10876), on its own body since #10880: at rest it hides under its dome as one more hummock, and its threat splits the dome open on orange-red plates.

kinds.name: Ribbon-stalker
kinds.$comment: Cave wildlife (#10876), on its own body since #10881: at rest it stands still among the ribbon curtains, banded and hung with flaps like one more hanging ribbon.

kinds.name: Stalk-bill
kinds.$comment: Cave wildlife (#10876), on its own body since #10881: it stands still for hours as one more pale stalk among the funnels, walks at a slow stalk, and spears what comes near.

kinds.name: Drop-sloth
kinds.$comment: Cave wildlife (#10876); its own body (#10877), hanging from the grove's ceiling at rest and dropping when it wakes.

kinds.name: Draft-hound
kinds.$comment: Cave wildlife (#10876); its own body (#10878), a pack resting into the cave's draft with its ear-fans held up, so it hears what comes down the draft at its full wake range and what comes from downwind at only 0.3 of it; it flares the fans to search.

kinds.name: Salt-monitor
kinds.$comment: Cave wildlife (#10876); its own body (#10879) on the saurian rig, lying belly-down at rest among the heath's dried flowstone, walking with a monitor's side-to-side bend.

kinds.name: Glass-courser
kinds.$comment: Cave wildlife (#10876); its own body (#10878), lying flat at rest with its glowing crest raised like one of the steppe's tufts.

kinds.name: Seep-rat
kinds.$comment: Cave wildlife (#10876), on its own body since #10880: a colony rests packed belly-down around its seep, and pours out together when one wakes.

kinds.name: Plume-neck
kinds.$comment: Cave wildlife (#10876), on its own body since #10882: it stands upright and still among the orchard's tubes, runs on all fours, and flares its crimson ruff wide before it strikes.

breath.$comment: #10882 (Patch): a weird miasma from the open mouth with each roar and bite, not fire. Shares of each clip at which a burst leaves the mouth; reaches are along the jaws' joints in the mesh's metres; colours sRGB.

kinds.name: Ruin collector
kinds.$comment: The main ruin inhabitant (#10956), the collectors' common foe: a low crouch on bent legs, long arms hanging, a blade in its right hand, and a shell worn like equipment. Its shells and blade are rigid pieces hung from its joints (worn). Ruin placement is #10955; until then craft.creatures.hunter places it.

kinds.name: Ruin skitterer
kinds.$comment: The alternative ruin inhabitant (#10957), a skitterer: faceless, compact and quick, its segmented shell its body's own, a knife in its right hand (worn: held only). Ruin placement is #10955; until then craft.creatures.hunter places it.

kinds.name: Implement-carrier
kinds.$comment: A special ruin inhabitant (#10957): tall on very long legs under a wide cap, carrying an enigmatic crescent whose amber core glows and lights what is near (worn: held only, with its light). Its crescent drinks light (#10966, settled with Patch): raised in its display at a lit lantern within 10 m and in its sight, the lantern gutters and goes out for 6 s, then sputters back over 1 s; it raises it again at most every 20 s while it hunts. Its thrust strikes as a blow. Ruin placement is #10955.

kinds.name: Blade-limbed special
kinds.$comment: A special ruin inhabitant (#10958): very long legs under a beetle dome, two grasping arms, and two scythe-blade limbs on its back that sweep up and out in its threat and come down together in its blow. Rare; at the heart of a large ruin (#10955).

kinds.name: Threshold lurker
kinds.$comment: A ruin skitterer (#10959): a low ambusher that rests sunk into the floor under a ruined doorway, only its shield's top showing, and bursts up as the player passes (its threat), then rams and claws. Ruin placement under thresholds is #10955.

kinds.name: Shard dweller
kinds.$comment: A ruin skitterer (#10959): a small soft body under a carried shard of the ruin, which it raises as a shield, reaching out from under it with long three-digit arms.

kinds.name: Wall runner
kinds.$comment: A ruin skitterer (#10959): a flat quick body on four spread pad-footed limbs with a whip tail. It runs on walls and ceilings in its design; until the Engine moves and routes bodies on walls (rusty-engine #10967) it runs on floors only.

kinds.name: Channel sifter
kinds.$comment: A ruin tender (#10960): it wades the Ancients' water channels on three legs, sifting with the comb fan under its hood. Tenders threaten indirectly: when disturbed it rears and puffs glowing amber spores from its pods (breath). The spores' mark is proposed on the board ('Ruin wildlife: the ecology'); until Patch settles it the puff is a look only and its shove a weak blow.

breath.$comment: #10960: amber spores puffed from the pods along its sides as it rears in its threat; a look only until the mark is settled. Emitted between the spine's and chest's joints, drifting out and rising; colours sRGB.

kinds.name: Stilt runner
kinds.$comment: Ruin skitterers in packs (#10960): melon-sized shell bodies on three needle legs, each with one whip arm that lashes. They run in a quick jittering rush and flank like the draft-hound pack, and peck at the relic lights at rest.

kinds.name: Brood bearer
kinds.$comment: A ruin tender (#10961): broad and low on six padded legs, carrying six pods of small skitterers in cups on its back. Settled with Patch (wiki 'Ruins wildlife', Tenders' indirect threats): threatened, it splits its pods once and the brood defends it while it shuffles away. Until the pods are built it shows its threat and gives a weak shove.

brood.$comment: Settled with Patch (#10961): small skitterers, one a pod; they guard it within 15 m; its pods regrow over a game day (1200 s).

kinds.name: Mender
kinds.$comment: A ruin tender (#10961): a dome on four long legs with six handling arms that smooth new shell over cracks. Settled with Patch (wiki 'Ruins wildlife', Tenders' indirect threats): on seeing the player it seals the nearest doorway of the player's room with a membrane. Until the seal is built it shows its threat and gives a weak shove; its rest is its smoothing work (feed).

seals.$comment: Settled with Patch (#10961): about 4 s to seal; a fresh seal falls to 2-3 blows, one a minute old takes about three times as many; two seals near the player, then 90 s to refill. It seals a doorway within reachMetres of where it stands.

kinds.name: Chime grazer
kinds.$comment: A ruin tender (#10962): a long plated grazer on four slim legs that feeds on the amber growth at relic lights, its slotted crest folded back along its plates like a wing. Settled with Patch (wiki 'Ruins wildlife', Tenders' indirect threats): disturbed, it lifts its crest and rings it, and the chime calls other ruin life; a blow cuts the ring short. It never fights. Its rest is grazing.

calls.$comment: Settled with Patch (#10962): the ring lasts its display (about 3 s); it calls every other ruin hunter within about 40 m, tenders excepted; it can ring again about 60 s after the last.

kinds.name: Brood skitterer
kinds.$comment: A brood bearer's brood (#10961, Patch: 'Small skitterers work'): the skitterer's body at under half its size, without its knife. Only a bearer's split pods release them, already hunting; they come at once, weak and quick, and guard their bearer.

kinds.name: Niche unfolder
kinds.$comment: A ruin fixture (#10963), settled with Patch on den-wiki wandering-years/ruins-wildlife ('Fixtures as hazards'): seated folded in a rounded wall recess, it seizes a player who stays within its reach while it unfolds, holding them and drawing them toward the recess, until its hold runs out, a blow lands on it or a sprint against it breaks free; then it folds away and rests. Rooted; placed by test aid until #10955.

fixture.$comment: Settled with Patch (#10963): within 2.5 m of the recess (2.9 m from its middle), a 0.6 s unfold, a hold of up to 3 s at 2 a second, a 1 s sprint against it breaks free (spending stamina), then about 20 s folded away.

kinds.name: Vault filter
kinds.$comment: A ruin fixture (#10963), settled with Patch on den-wiki wandering-years/ruins-wildlife ('Fixtures as hazards'): three lobes hanging from a ceiling root by a relic light. A player passing beneath sees its fringes shiver, then its lobes drop and lash: a sting, and their stamina empties and stays empty for a while, so they cannot sprint or climb. Its lobes rise and it rests. Each third of its health lost cuts a lobe off. Rooted, drawn lifted to its own ceiling; placed by test aid until #10955.

fixture.$comment: Settled with Patch (#10963): passing within 1.5 m beneath it, a 0.5 s tell, then a sting of 3 and numbing for 10 s; its lobes rise again and it rests about 15 s. Its mesh hangs from a ceiling 3.4 m up.

kinds.name: Folding bower
kinds.$comment: A ruin fixture (#10963), settled with Patch on den-wiki wandering-years/ruins-wildlife ('Fixtures as hazards'): a room-sized pavilion of ribs and amber membranes where ruin life rests. A player who stays under its ribs hears them creak; then it folds shut, its walls blocking passage, and digests them while they are inside, until three blows cut its membrane and it opens. Left empty it opens after a while. Rooted; placed by test aid until #10955.

fixture.$comment: Settled with Patch (#10963): staying under its ribs (within 2 m of its middle) through its 1.5 s creak, it shuts; 1 damage every 2 s inside; three blows cut its membrane; it opens about 30 s after it empties, and can shut again 5 s after it opens.

kinds.name: Brood vessel
kinds.$comment: A ruin fixture (#10963), settled with Patch on den-wiki wandering-years/ruins-wildlife ('Fixtures as hazards'): four amber vessels in pale pod frames on rooted stems. While it sees the player within its reach, or after a blow, a vessel swells and splits, and a small skitterer climbs out to guard it; another follows every 20 s until its vessels are spent. Two blows smash a whole vessel. Spent vessels regrow after a few game days. Rooted; placed by test aid until #10955.

fixture.$comment: Settled with Patch (#10963): within 12 m in its sight, a vessel swells (1.2 s) and splits every 20 s, a small skitterer each, guarding it within 15 m; two blows smash a whole vessel; spent vessels regrow after three game days (3600 s).
